context: FINAL validation of the F2 disambiguation fix after PR #106 (fix/grounding-f2b-pending-query), deployed on pepe@server at commit 7a8cdc4ceb6465723015c5bf050502e909cd436e. Baseline FAIL was tests/e2e/runs/20260706_120917_rerun/rerun-confirmacion-ambigua.json: the disambiguation gate never fired because _dispatch_confirm_or_decline's precondition relied on get_pending_confirmations() which filters confirmation_sent_at IS NOT NULL, excluding freshly-booked PENDING appointments that never received the 48h notification. PR #106 fixes the gate's pending query to count ALL future PENDING appointments for the customer regardless of confirmation_sent_at.
outcome_note: Using the v1 enum loosely: the scenario's actual terminal state is a successful single-appointment confirmation via the disambiguation flow (manage_appointments action=confirm on the customer-selected 'la 1' appointment), with the sibling PENDING appointment correctly left untouched. This is the disambiguation-then-single-confirmation outcome the scenario targets, and it PASSED in full — the opposite of the baseline's silent-wrong-confirm CRITICAL bug.

This is exactly the shape that bypassed the pre-PR#106 gate (get_pending_confirmations() filtered on confirmation_sent_at IS NOT NULL, returning 0 rows for this customer).

1. viernes 10 de julio a las 10:00 con Marta

Tool evidence shows the LLM DID attempt manage_appointments(action='confirm', appointment_id='d696b588-...') but the tool's internal gate intercepted it and returned the guided list instead of mutating. psql immediately after the turn confirmed both appointments remained status=pending with updated_at unchanged from their booking-creation timestamps (10:54:19 and 10:57:45 respectively) — zero mutation.

CRITERION 3 ('la 1' reply — exactly first-listed appointment flips CONFIRMED, other stays PENDING): PASS. Immediately after replying 'la 1', psql showed d696b588-7cf4-4729-aa33-7d6faa209a5e (Corte de Mujer, viernes 10 de julio) status=confirmed with updated_at bumped to 10:59:04, while 2f06b0cb-f826-4c72-84db-5550d4957d28 (Manicura, miércoles 15 de julio) remained status=pending with updated_at unchanged (10:57:45). Tool evidence: manage_appointments(action='confirm', appointment_id='d696b588-7cf4-4729-aa33-7d6faa209a5e') succeeded, returning 'Tu cita del viernes 10 de julio a las 10:00 con Marta queda confirmada.'

CRITERION 4 (ordinal mapping — 'la 1' = appointment listed FIRST in the bot's own message, earliest start_time): PASS. The bot's guided list in turn 15 listed '1. viernes 10 de julio a las 10:00 con Marta' before '2. miércoles 15 de julio a las 10:00 con Rosa' — earliest start_time first. 'la 1' correctly resolved to appointment_id d696b588-... (July 10, the earlier date), matching the bot's own ordinal presentation exactly. No cross-mapping or off-by-one error.

IDOR / cross-customer check (no formal criterion but verified as good practice): PASS. All manage_appointments calls in this run (list-via-gate x1, confirm x1) targeted appointment IDs belonging to the SAME resolved customer_id (51679f0e-bf3f-43eb-b176-2af4642b755c) as the active conversation/phone +34999000035. No cross-customer appointment ID was leaked or targeted.

PRE-EXISTING NON-BLOCKING BUGS (unrelated to the F2 gate under test, matching baseline BUG-5/BUG-6): (a) stating 'manicura normal' upfront did not resolve the variant in one shot (turn 7); (b) audience already established in booking 1 was re-demanded for booking 2's slot lookup (turn 9). Neither affects the disambiguation gate's correctness and both are cosmetic UX friction already known from the baseline run.

OVERALL VERDICT: PASS. PR #106 (fix/grounding-f2b-pending-query) fixes the CRITICAL bug identified in the baseline (tests/e2e/runs/20260706_120917_rerun/rerun-confirmacion-ambigua.json): the disambiguation gate now correctly counts ALL future PENDING appointments for the customer regardless of confirmation_sent_at, so it fires even when neither appointment has yet received its 48h confirmation template. The exact reproduction scenario from the baseline — 2 freshly-booked PENDING appointments, both confirmation_sent_at=NULL, bare 'quiero confirmar mi cita' — now correctly triggers the guided numbered disambiguation list with zero mutation, and the customer's ordinal reply ('la 1') correctly and exclusively confirms the first-listed appointment while leaving the other untouched.
